etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Latin conterminus, from con- (“with”) + terminus (“border, end”), equivalent to co- +‎ terminous. The spelling with co- instead of con- is probably influenced by the related prefix co-.
senses: (geography) Having matching boundaries; or, adjoining and sharing a boundary.
(by extension) Having the same scope, range of meaning, or extent in time.
